entities.name: Niccolò dell'Arca
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Niccolò dell'Arca was an Italian Early Renaissance sculptor, who worked mostly in terracotta. He is also known under the names Niccolò da Ragusa, Niccolò da Bari, Niccolò dall'Arca, and Niccolò d'Antonio d'Apulia. The surname "dell'Arca" refers to his contribution to the Arca di San Domenico.
